[!cgo] skip 'cgo is not available'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo

logos run .
stdout '^owned C: 3 7 11 15$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o $WORK/out
cd $WORK/out
env GOEXPERIMENT=
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go vet ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.com/cgoowned

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- main.lgo --
package main

/*
typedef unsigned long word;
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

type Local C.int

const values = []C.int{1, 2}
const words = []C.word{3, 4}
const array = [2]C.int{5, 6}
const locals = []Local{7, 8}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("owned C:", values[0]+values[1], words[0]+words[1], array[0]+array[1], locals[0]+locals[1])
}
